|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Strike Planning (V)]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023) (PDF created 17 June 2023), cut unchanged from page 6. The current text is [[Strike Planning (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Strike Planning (V)]]): the card image at official release (5 March 2023)<ref name="ht-53a6001">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd 53a6001] “Virtual Set 21 Preview Cards”, 5 March 2023.</ref> prints: “If an [A New Hope] objective on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may ▲ Mon Mothma or any general. During your first turn, while Stolen Data Tapes at Dune Sea, [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploys -6 there. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-6e6f7f7">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/6e6f7f7 swccg-card-json commit 6e6f7f7] “Set 21 Preview and Errata” (5 March 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 6, file created 17 June 2023: “If an [A New Hope] objective on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may ▲ Mon Mothma or any general. During your first turn, while Stolen Data Tapes at Dune Sea, [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploys -6 there. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Strike Planning (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Strike Planning”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Strike Planning (V)]] (published 5 March 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Strike Planning]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Strike Planning (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Unless opponent’s [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader. May ▼ [Death Star II] Falcon to Endor system. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-304ab4f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f swccg-card-json commit 304ab4f] “Set 24” (29 December 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The deploy condition “If an [A New Hope] objective on table” became “If Rebel Strike Team on table”; “Unless opponent’s [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system.” was added; the twice-per-game ▲ (take into hand from Reserve Deck) changed from “Mon Mothma or any general” to “an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader”; the first-turn [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploy −6 at Dune Sea was replaced by “May ▼ [Death Star II] Falcon to Endor system.” (▼ = deploy from Reserve Deck). The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
